players.name: Tip Reiman
players.summary: The Cardinals moved Reiman (ankle) from the active/PUP list to the reserve/PUP list Sunday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

players.name: James Conner
players.summary: The Cardinals are placing Conner (foot) on injured reserve with a designation to return, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM Phoenix reports.

players.name: Tua Tagovailoa
players.summary: Coach Kevin Stefanski said Tagovailoa (oblique) won't take part in Wednesday's practice, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

players.summary: ir

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.summary: Lane (wrist) is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days, potentially as soon as Wednesday, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

players.name: Devontez Walker
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Flowers (hamstring) is considered day-to-day, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sun reports.

players.name: Ty Johnson
players.summary: Johnson (hamstring) was a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.summary: out

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.summary: Coker is in a walking boot Monday after sustaining a left ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Bears, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Tyson Bagent
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.summary: Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Dillon Gabriel
players.summary: ir

players.name: Malik Davis
players.summary: The Cowboys placed Davis (hip) on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.summary: Pacheco (back) underwent surgery Monday and is expected to be out for a significant amount of time, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

players.name: Josh Whyle
players.summary: Whyle (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Vikings.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: Jacobs (personal) remains on the Commissioner's Exempt List, but the NFL may count time on the list as time served if it eventually issues a suspension to the running back, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that Pierce is "good right now" after banging up his wrist in Sunday's 41-23 loss to the Ravens, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Carson Towt
players.summary: ir

players.name: Sean McKeon
players.summary: questionable

players.name: D.J. Montgomery
players.summary: Montgomery (abdomen) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: Mallory (thumb) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday with a designation to return, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.summary: Coach Liam Coen said Monday that Thomas (shoulder) will be limited in practice this week, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jimmy Holiday
players.summary: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: The knee injury Bowers is recovering from "is not overly serious," and it's "possible" he could return in Week 2, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
players.summary: The Chargers placed Lambert-Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Derius Davis
players.summary: Davis (undisclosed) is day-to-day with an injury he suffered during Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh labeled McConkey (rib) as day-to-day Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Harbaugh added that the Chargers will see how McConkey progresses throughout the week before determining his availability for Sunday's game agains the Raiders.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Mason is being further evaluated after experiencing thumb soreness coming out of Sunday's 39-22 win over the Packers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray is in concussion protocol and will be evaluated day by day leading up Sunday's road game in Chicago, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Ben Yurosek
players.summary: Minnesota placed Yurosek on injured reserve Tuesday due to an undisclosed injury.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel said Henderson (ankle) will practice Monday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown, who was officially placed on injured reserve Saturday, is expected to miss about six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Oscar Delp
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Audric Estime
players.summary: The Saints placed Estime (thigh) on injured reserve Saturday, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

players.name: Kene Nwangwu
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: Cooper (ankle) is "week-to-week," and the hope is he returns "within the next four weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Tim Patrick
players.summary: The Jets placed Patrick (groin) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling (ankle) is expected to miss at least one month after he was diagnosed Sunday with a deltoid sprain of his left ankle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jake Tonges
players.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan said after Thursday night's win over the Rams that Tonges' knee injury "does not look good," Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tory Horton
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Darnold (glute) is "looking at about a four-week return to play" but could return "a little bit sooner than that," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Sean Tucker
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: questionable

players.name: David Sills V
players.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.summary: Okonkwo is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 1 game against Philadelphia due to a hamstring injury.
